messages:
tara: Quick sync 3: noisy pagers from autofallback on public checkout routes. Idea: cluster similar fallbacks into a single digest, keep an immutable decision_trace, surface one redacted sample in UI.
owen: Sounds good. Two constraints: flat audit event for stream consumers, and a short humanized reason for the console.
mina: UX: rollout row shows a tiny badge (green/amber/red). Clicking opens audit card: timeline + redacted excerpt + human reason + machine code. Add a link to the rollout version.
alert-bot: policy reminder: any non-redacted excerpt requires compliance approval. Schema changes need a 2-week staged rollout.
tara: Implementation sketch: routing emits flat event to stream, sanitizer replaces PII and writes final audit record with retention tag. We'll add `alert_eligible:false` tag for digested routes.
owen: Proposed flat audit shape (one-line JSON example) so infra/ui teams can implement: 
```json
{"evt":"fb_4891","ts":4891122334,"route":"checkout/submit","rollout":"rl_2026_canary","decision_code":"LATENCY_P90","decision_human":"p90 latency breach","degrade_type":"graceful","original_model":"large-v2","fallback_model":"medium-quant","latency_ms":"1420","prompt_sig":"sha256:aa11","excerpt":"[redacted] ...","redaction_level":"partial","telemetry_tags":"fallback,digest,alert_eligible:false","retention_days":"30"}
```
mina: Good. A couple notes: keep `telemetry_tags` CSV (flat), `retention_days` as string to avoid nested types, and limit `excerpt` to 512 chars.
ops-lead: Playbook idea: page only if unique_routes_impacted_5m >= 5 OR grouped_fallback_clusters_1m >= 3 with total_events_1m >= 12. Otherwise send digest to #oncall and pin the rollout in console. Add emergency opt-out per-route.
tara: Also store `decision_trace_sig` (sha256) referencing the long-term decision_trace stream for forensic. Decision_trace stream retention = 365d, redacted samples = 30d.
owen: Dashboard panels: digested_vs_paged, grouped_clusters_over_time, suppressed_page_count. These help tune thresholds during experiment.
mina: UX: show a short explanation on audit card when digest suppressed a page, e.g. "suppressed: 4 similar fallbacks clustered in 3m". That reduces confusion. Add a gated "replay" button (admin-only) that runs in a sandbox and logs an audit entry.
alert-bot: note: run migration plan for schema change, include sanitizer runbook.
ops-lead: Action items: owen -> PR with flat schema + examples, mina -> console mockups + copy, tara -> migration + migration window, ops-lead -> finalize paging thresholds and playbook. We'll reconvene next Tue. :thumbsup:
